subject: lead-attention-required: Alpha3 support is on main but runtime app patch not observed
body: Revalidated current GitHub main. HEAD is efb6be2a99a65d3f432b3bac42b16e296b25b640 (two commits ahead of 413d4a7). The delta adds the Alpha3 support/apply workflow and payload, but at this HEAD app/src/main/java/com/duoopen/fold/Fold7AngleAuthority.kt is absent; app HingeAngleSource still contains the legacy externalActive/EXTERNAL_STALE_MS path and DuoApp still constructs its own HingeAngleSource. Therefore the intended Alpha3 single-authority runtime is not yet present on main as of this HEAD. This does not contradict the Alpha3 design; it is a deployment-state drift the lead should reconcile before assuming the runtime changes landed. Direct private-sensor replacement remains unproven.
